summary: Completed e2e testing of Food Search and Food Details features. All requested features working correctly: 1) Search for 'eggs'/'chicken' returns results with Foundation/SR Legacy foods ranked first, 2) Clicking search result navigates to /food/:fdcId page, 3) Food details page shows Back to Search button, macros, amino acids, fatty acids, 4) Add to Log dialog opens and logs food successfully, 5) Mobile viewport displays properly with bottom navigation.

minor.issue: Some USDA FDC IDs return 404 (e.g., 748967) - transient external USDA API issue, not app bug

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - minor chart sizing issue on initial render, does not affect functionality
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - accessibility improvement opportunity

passed_tests: Backend API: GET /api/foods/search?query=eggs - returns results
Backend API: Search prioritizes Foundation/SR Legacy foods (3+/5 top results have amino acid data)
Backend API: Search response has correct structure (foods, total_hits, current_page)
Backend API: GET /api/foods/{fdcId} - returns food details
Backend API: Food details includes macros (protein, fat, carbs, calories)
Backend API: Food details includes amino acids for SR Legacy foods (18 amino acids)
Backend API: Food details includes fatty acids (8 fatty acids)
Backend API: Invalid food ID returns 404
Backend API: POST /api/logs - creates food log entry
Backend API: GET /api/favorites/check/{fdcId} - returns favorite status
Backend API: POST /api/favorites - adds food to favorites
Frontend: Search page loads with search input and categories
Frontend: Search for 'chicken' returns results with data-testid='food-result-X'
Frontend: Results show 'AA Data' badge for Foundation/SR Legacy foods
Frontend: Clicking result navigates to /food/:fdcId
Frontend: Food details page shows Back to Search button
Frontend: Food details page shows Add to Log button
Frontend: Food details page shows Favorite button
Frontend: Food details shows macros grid (Protein, Calories, Fat, Carbs)
Frontend: Food details shows Complete Protein badge for complete proteins
Frontend: Food details shows Amino Acid Profile radar chart
Frontend: Food details shows Amino Acid list with essential markers
Frontend: Food details shows Fatty Acid Profile section
Frontend: Add to Log dialog has servings input, meal type select, confirm button
Frontend: Back to Search button navigates back to /search
Frontend: Mobile viewport (390x844) displays properly
Frontend: Bottom navigation visible on mobile (Dashboard, Food, Barcode, etc.)
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding aria-describedby to Dialog components for better accessibility
Recharts chart components may need explicit minWidth/minHeight to avoid initial sizing warnings
